subject: V1 workshop: workflow suggestions welcome, without delaying discussion
body:
CFA Nova — Ziggy explicitly invites your workflow suggestions for the ongoing V1 workshop. This appends to coordination copy 2b7e1638-4324-4911-833d-1277483b1cf8; no duplicate brief or new assignment.

Chief has accepted direct supervision, evidence/scope audit and correction versions preserving originals. His actual critique is:
docs/notes/explorable_world/comfy/projects/collaborators/reviewer_prototypes_20261014/v1_workshop/CHIEF_WORKSHOP_RESPONSE_20261013.md
SHA256 14fd24eac1eea41e35fb30f74bf7b692a02789f022d63e54597f89899c6b4baf.
He proposes blind filenames, decoys/duplicate, chin crops, mirror/build observations, existing-schema returns, calibration first then Lisan COV-00 after actual generation/dispatch.

Please suggest practical corrections from our real workflow: criterion/scope tolerances, evidence/provenance and import compatibility, useful bounded calibration, four unbound packet assets and exploratory observations. Your response is welcome but MUST NOT gate workshop progress; we will continue while it is pending.

Ziggy reports V1 is created and standing by. Its brief, activation and calibration stay on hold until this working session settles and Ziggy releases it. No tests, site edits, asset promotion or provider execution are requested. Browser operation remains yours alone if needed; this invitation is mailbox-posted, not a delivery/read claim.
